entries.text: 不论是谁，只要和宝可梦在一起，\n就是宝可梦训练家！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_23

entries.text: 我们宝可梦训练家\n要通过对战让宝可梦变强！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_24

entries.text: 哎～你可真会吊人胃口！\n我都快按捺不住了！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_02

entries.text: 很好！我等你很久了！\n这次我的宝可梦是……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_03

entries.text: 妮莫同学。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_01

entries.text: 这可是[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学第一次！\n……进行宝可梦对战哦。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_02

entries.text: 啊哈哈……\n我差点一不小心就派出\r\n平时用的宝可梦了。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_04

entries.text: 这样的话……\n那我就让刚才的孩子完成首秀吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_05

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n让我们来一场大有收获的对战吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_06

entries.text: 想不到你第一次对战就打赢了，\n你比我想象的要更厉害！\r\n我相信你一定会变得更强的！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_07a

entries.text: 第一次就能对战到这个程度，\n看来你很有训练家的资质啊！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_07b

entries.text: 我正好也想试试其他的战术，\n不如我们再比一次吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_08

entries.text: 啊，不好意思。\n我太兴奋了，不知不觉地就……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_09

entries.text: 我不在意
entries.label: common_0090_select_01

entries.text: 有机会再来对战吧
entries.label: common_0090_select_02

entries.text: 嗯，有机会再对战！\n要说话算话哦！！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_11b

entries.text: 你们才刚认识不久，\n就已经变得这么要好了啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_04

entries.text: 你这个冠军\n要多教[VAR 0x1100(00FF,0101)]他她些东西哦。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_05

entries.text: 对了，[VAR 0x0100(0000)]！\n既然你才刚接触宝可梦……[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_13

entries.text: 那就一定要装上那个App！\c\n你有手机吗？\n让我帮你弄一下吧。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_14

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]可以用手机洛托姆\n打开[VAR 0xFF00(0006)]宝可梦图鉴[VAR 0xFF00(0000)]了！
entries.label: common_0090_system_01

entries.text: 自己捉到的宝可梦\n会被自动添加到\r\n宝可梦图鉴当中。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_15

entries.text: 作为宝可梦训练家，要特别关注！\n这是班主任吉尼亚老师制作的\r\n一款很厉害的App哦！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_16

entries.text: 在我那个时代，一提到图鉴，\n都是在笔记本上手写的。\r\n世界发展得真是让人充满期待啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_06

entries.text: 图鉴要靠手写，真不得了！\n我甚至都无法想象！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_17

entries.text: 呵呵……\n想必也是啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_07

entries.text: 不过，即使时代变了，\n与宝可梦相遇的那份感动\r\n也都不会褪色。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_08

entries.text: 与宝可梦有多少次相遇，就会为你们\n带来多少次大幅成长的机会。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_09

entries.text: 请以完成图鉴为目标，\n好好努力吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_10

entries.text: 我有事要和\n妮莫同学的家人说……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_11

entries.text: 如果妮莫同学你肯带着\n[VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学到学院的话，\r\n我会很感谢你的……[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_12

entries.text: 没～问题！\n交给我吧！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_18

entries.text: 有你在我就放心了。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_13

entries.text: 那好，你就跟我一起走吧。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_14

entries.text: 耶喵。
entries.label: common_0090_grass_01

entries.text: 呆哇～
entries.label: common_0090_fire_01

entries.text: 噗噗。
entries.label: common_0090_water_01

entries.text: 看来不光是对战，\n图鉴我也要加把劲啊。[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_19

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]，\n话说野生的宝可梦……\r\n你还没有捉到过吧！？[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_21

entries.text: 去学校之前，让我来教你怎么捉好了！\n跟我来吧～！[VAR 0x0114(0004)]
entries.label: common_0090_rival_22

entries.text: [VAR 0x0100(0000)]同学，\n去学校时路上要小心啊。[VAR 0x0114(000A)]
entries.label: common_0090_head_teacher_15
